question: Pandit Ravi Shankar, founder of National Orchestra of India, was a __________ player.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sitar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar** was a legendary sitar player and composer.
 
• He was instrumental in popularizing Indian classical music in the Western world.
 
• In addition to founding the National Orchestra of India, he collaborated with many international artists, including George Harrison of The Beatles.
 
• His contributions to music have earned him numerous awards, including Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar** was born on April 7, 1920, and passed away on December 11, 2012.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Vibhushan** in 1981 and the **Padma Bhushan** in 1967.
 
• Shankar's influence extended beyond music; he played a significant role in cultural exchange between India and the world.
 
• He also served as a nominated member of the Rajya Sabha, the upper house of the Indian Parliament, from 1986 to 1992.
 
• His autobiography, "Raga Mala," provides a deep insight into his life and musical journey.
